Definition: from G575 and G5099; to pay in full:--repay.
BiblicalUsage: Paul writes to Philemon about Onesimus and puts his own name to the debt: I will repay it. The word is payment in full, a promise made in writing by a man who means to keep it.
TheologicalSignificance: A debt owned honestly is a debt that can be paid, and Paul shows us how to carry someone else's cost.
